name: Dry dog food
definition: complete dry kibble food made for dogs.

name: Wet dog food
definition: complete canned or pouched moist food made for dogs.

name: Fresh or frozen dog food
definition: chilled or frozen prepared or raw food made for dogs.

name: Freeze-dried or air-dried dog food
definition: dehydrated raw or cooked food made for dogs.

name: Veterinary diet (dog)
definition: food formulated for a dog's health need and sold as a diet beside dry and wet.

name: Dog treat
definition: a reward or snack for dogs that is not a complete food.

name: Dog crate
definition: a box or cage in which a dog is kept or transported at home.

name: Dog kennel
definition: an outdoor house for a dog.

name: Dog bed
definition: a bed, cushion or basket made for a dog to sleep on.

name: Dog collar
definition: a band worn round a dog's neck.

name: Dog lead
definition: a line used to hold or walk a dog.

name: Dog harness
definition: straps worn round a dog's body to hold or walk it.

name: Dog coat
definition: a garment made to be worn by a dog.

name: Dog toy
definition: an object made for a dog to chew, fetch, tug or play with.

name: Dog agility equipment
definition: obstacles and gear for dog sport and training.

name: Dry cat food
definition: complete dry kibble food made for cats.

name: Cat tree
definition: a free-standing or pole-fixed climbing and resting structure made for cats.

name: Cat litter
definition: absorbent material made for a cat's toilet.

name: Small-animal food
definition: food made for rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters and other small mammals.

name: Small-animal cage or hutch
definition: a cage, habitat or hutch in which a small mammal is housed.

name: English saddle
definition: a saddle of the English riding tradition.

name: Western saddle
definition: a saddle of the Western riding tradition.

name: Saddle pad or numnah
definition: a pad worn under a saddle.

name: Bridle
definition: headgear with reins by which a horse is steered.

name: Snaffle bit
definition: a direct-pressure bit.

name: Curb bit
definition: a leverage bit.

name: Bitless bridle (hackamore)
definition: headgear that steers without a mouthpiece.

name: Headcollar or halter
definition: headgear used to lead or tie a horse.

name: Turnout rug
definition: a waterproof rug (blanket) worn by a horse outdoors.

name: Stable rug
definition: a rug (blanket) worn by a horse indoors.

name: Fly mask
definition: a mesh mask worn over a horse's face against flies.

name: Tendon boot
definition: a protective boot worn on a horse's leg.

name: Horse grooming brush
definition: a brush made for grooming a horse.

name: Fish food
definition: food made for aquarium or pond fish.

name: Aquarium (tank)
definition: a glass or acrylic tank in which fish are kept.

name: Canister filter
definition: an external filter in a closed canister fed by hoses.

name: Hang-on-back filter
definition: a filter hung on the rear of the tank.

name: Internal filter
definition: a filter placed inside the tank.

name: Sump
definition: a separate tank below the aquarium that holds filtration.

name: Under-gravel filter
definition: a filter plate laid under the gravel.

name: Aquarium heater
definition: a heater that warms aquarium water.

name: Aquarium light
definition: a lamp or light unit made for an aquarium.

name: Aquarium substrate
definition: gravel, sand or other bed material for the tank floor.

name: Aquarium decoration
definition: ornaments, rock, wood and other furnishings for a tank.

name: Water test kit
definition: a kit that tests aquarium water.

name: Reptile food
definition: prepared food made for reptiles and amphibians.

name: Frozen feeder animal
definition: a dead frozen animal sold as food for reptiles; live feeders are out.

name: Vivarium or terrarium
definition: an empty enclosure in which reptiles or amphibians are kept.

name: Basking lamp
definition: a lamp that gives a reptile a heated basking spot.

name: Ceramic heat emitter
definition: a heat source that gives heat without light.

name: Deep heat projector
definition: a heat source that projects infrared heat.

name: Heat mat
definition: a heating pad fitted on or against the enclosure.

name: Reptile thermostat
definition: a control that regulates enclosure heat.

name: UVB lamp
definition: a lamp that gives ultraviolet B light to a reptile.

name: Reptile substrate
definition: floor material for a reptile enclosure.

name: Reptile hide
definition: a shelter in which a reptile hides.

name: Wild bird seed
definition: seed or seed mix made for wild birds.

name: Suet or fat ball
definition: a fat-based wild bird food.

name: Tube feeder
definition: a hanging seed tube with ports.

name: Hopper feeder
definition: a seed feeder with a hopper and a tray.

name: Suet feeder
definition: a feeder that holds suet blocks or cakes.

name: Nyjer feeder
definition: a feeder made for fine nyjer seed.

name: Peanut mesh feeder
definition: a steel-mesh feeder for peanuts.

name: Ground feeder
definition: a feeder or tray set at ground level.

name: Bird feeding station
definition: a stand or table carrying several feeders.

name: Nest box
definition: a box made for wild birds to nest in.

name: Bird bath
definition: a basin that gives wild birds water to drink and bathe in.

name: Bee feeder
definition: a device that gives bees syrup or other feed.

name: Framed vertical hive
definition: a hive that grows upward with frames in stacked boxes.

name: Long hive
definition: a horizontal frame hive.

name: Top-bar hive
definition: a hive whose combs hang from bars.

name: Warre hive
definition: a vertical hive that grows downward with bars in stacked boxes.

name: Smoker
definition: a tool that blows smoke to calm bees.

name: Honey extractor
definition: a machine that spins honey from combs.

name: Uncapping knife or fork
definition: a tool that removes wax cappings from combs.

name: Honey bottling bucket or tank
definition: a bucket or tank that holds honey for bottling.

name: Poultry starter feed
definition: complete feed for chicks.

name: Poultry grower feed
definition: complete feed for growing birds.

name: Poultry layer feed
definition: complete feed for laying hens.

name: Scratch grain
definition: a grain mix fed to poultry as a supplement.

name: Poultry feeder or waterer
definition: a feeder or drinker made for poultry.

name: Chicken coop
definition: a house for backyard hens.

name: Small incubator
definition: a small egg incubator for pet or backyard use; commercial hatchers are not here.

name: Hay
definition: dried grass fed to horses, small mammals and other animals.

name: Food and water bowl
definition: a bowl or dish for food or water, made for more than one animal group.

name: Pet gate
definition: a gate sold only for pets.

name: Pet pen
definition: a pen sold only for pets.

name: Pet camera
definition: a camera sold only for pets.

name: Pet carrier
definition: a carrier that holds an animal and is not a vehicle.

name: Flea, tick and worm treatment
definition: a medicine against parasites in pets.

name: Pet ID tag
definition: a tag worn by a pet that carries its identity.

name: Identification microchip
definition: an implanted chip that identifies an animal.

name: Microchip scanner
definition: a reader of pet identification microchips.

name: GPS pet tracker
definition: a device that tracks a pet's location by GPS.

name: Hive body or super
definition: a box of a hive.

name: Frame
definition: a hive frame that carries comb.

name: Girth
definition: a strap that holds a saddle on a horse.

name: Aquarium filter media
definition: filter material made for one aquarium filter.
